description: Winding, insulation, insertion, fusing, balancing and testing equipment for brushed, brushless and universal motors — supplied as individual machines or complete turnkey production lines. Built in Taichung, Taiwan since 1992.

heroImage._source: A real Teamwork stator winding line, replacing the old site's banner. Blurred and darkened once at 2560 and then downscaled, so the treatment looks identical at every width and there is no CSS filter repainting on scroll.
heroImage._blurIsDeliberate: The blur is a client instruction, not a style choice: this is a customer's production line and they will not expose a customer's process. 0x27 at 2560 (about 1% of the width) leaves the impression of a line - copper spools, winding heads, the run of stations - while defeating any reading of the layout, the panel labels or the station count. Do not reduce it for the sake of a sharper picture.
heroImage._exif: Stripped. The source was an iPhone photograph and carried camera and timestamp metadata.

contact.title: Contact and quotations
contact.heading: Tell us the part. We will tell you the line.
contact.lede: Send the stator, armature or rotor you need to produce, along with the output you are planning for. Specifications are never gated and there is no account to create.
contact.description: Request a quotation, ask for a specification, or book a video call with the Teamwork Automation engineering team in Taichung, Taiwan.

catalog.title: Catalogue downloads
catalog.heading: The full catalogue, on request
catalog.lede: Machine specifications on this site are open — nothing behind a form. The complete printed catalogue is available on request so we know who to follow up with.
catalog.description: Request the full Teamwork Automation machine catalogue.

_videoNote: A click-to-load facade, not an embed. Nothing from YouTube is requested until the reader presses play: the poster is served from this site as WebP, and only then is the iframe created. That keeps the third-party request off the critical path, keeps the page free of YouTube cookies for readers who never watch, and satisfies the no-autoplay rule - the video starts because a person asked it to. Host is youtube-nocookie.com.

video.title: A machine you can watch before you ask for a quotation.
video.lede: The TWM-929 winding an out-slot brushless stator, filmed on our floor in Taichung. Specification sheets describe a machine; watching one place wire tells you whether it can handle your part.
video.label: Play video: TWM-929 out-slot brushless motor stator winding machine running
video.note: Nothing loads from YouTube until you press play.

cta.title: Send us the part. We will tell you the line.
cta.lede: Tell us the stator, armature or rotor you need to produce and the output you are planning for, and we will come back with a machine selection or a full line layout. We have planned plants from zero for fifty listed manufacturers worldwide; the conversation starts with your part, not our catalogue.
cta.note: We reply within one business day. Specifications are never gated — only the full PDF catalogue asks for an email.

_langNote: Only languages that actually have pages may appear in the switcher. Listing 日本語 before the Japanese pages exist would repeat the 404 problem that shipped on 2026-07-29. Planned order: Japanese first (Nittoku's home market), then German (Elmotec, GROB, Aumann territory), then Spanish (Mexico, and the PLASTIMAGEN customer base). Translation must be done properly — machine translation of slot liner, knurling or fusing will be wrong, and wrong technical vocabulary is worse than no page.
